Rasulullaah ﷺ Repeats Himself Thrice to Make himself Understood
Hadhrat Abu Umaamah (RA) says, "When Rasulullaah ﷺ spoke (something of importance), he would repeat himself thrice so that he would be understood." [^2]
Hadhrat Aa'isha (RA) Instructs Hadhrat Ibn Abi Saa'ib to hold fast to Three Factors when Teaching

Hadhrat Sha'bi narrates that Hadhrat Aa'isha (RA) once said to the lecturer of Madinah Hadhrat Ibn Abi Saa'ib, "You must obey me in three factors, otherwise I shall oppose you most vehemently." Hadhrat Ibn Abi Saa'ib said, "I shall most definitely obey you, O Ummul Mu'mineen! What are they?" Hadhrat Aa'isha (RA) said, "(Firstly) Refrain from going out of your way to rhyme your du'aas because Rasulullaah ﷺ and the Sahabah (RA) never did this. (Secondly) You should deliver a lecture once every week. If you do not want to do so only once, you may do so twice or otherwise thrice at the most because you should never allow people to become tired of the Qur'aan. (Thirdly) I never want to find you going to people who are engaged in some discussion and then you cut short their talk (by starting your lecture). Rather leave them to talk and you start your lecture only when they approach you and ask you to talk." [^3]
The Conduct of Hadhrat Abdullaah bin Mas'ood (RA) when Teaching

Hadhrat Shaqeeq bin Salamah narrates that Hadhrat Abdullaah bin Mas'ood (RA) once came to them and said, "I know well that you people are sitting here but the only thing that prevents me from coming out to you every time is the fear of you getting tired. It was the practice of Rasulullaah ﷺ to consider us when delivering lectures for fear of ever tiring us out." [^4]
Hadhrat A'mash narrates that when Hadhrat Abdullaah bin Mas'ood (RA) once passed by a man delivering a lecture, he said, "O lecturer! Do not make the people despondent (of Allaah's mercy)." [^5]
Hadhrat Ali (RA) Describes a True Scholar

Hadhrat Ali (RA) once said, "Should I not inform you who a true scholar is. He is one who neither makes people despondent of Allaah's mercy nor grants them the licence to disobey Allaah.
